title: Monthly totals for non reps/time habits + simplified habit editing UX

requirements.summary: For non-(reps/time) habits, compute monthly totals as checked-days count and show Monthly total + Goal in the existing monthly totals/volumes area.
acceptanceCriteria: For a habit with unitType not equal to "reps" and not equal to "time", checking N days in a given month results in a displayed monthly total of N for that month.
For a habit with unitType "reps", the monthly total continues to be calculated as (per-completion volume for the month) × (completed days count) and displayed as it is today.
For a habit with unitType "time", the monthly total continues to be calculated as (per-completion minutes for the month) × (completed days count) and displayed as it is today (formatted time string).

For non-(reps/time) habits, the goal shown in the monthly total/volume area is the habit’s configured monthly volume value for that selected month (i.e., the same value currently edited/displayed in the habit’s volume field for the month).
User-facing labels are in English (e.g., "Monthly total" and "Goal").

file_operations.description: Adjust monthly total calculation logic: keep existing behavior for unitType "reps" and "time", but for all other unit types return the completed-days count (each checked day = +1). Also ensure helpers cleanly support retrieving the selected month’s configured volume/goal for display.

Update the monthly totals/volumes display area to show both "Monthly total" and "Goal" for non-(reps/time) habits using the habit’s selected-month volume value as the goal, while preserving the existing display for "reps" and "time" habits.

requirements.summary: Ensure the "16/8 fasting" habit follows the non-(reps/time) monthly total behavior and shows goal alongside monthly total in the existing totals area.
acceptanceCriteria: When the unit type for the "16/8 fasting" habit is set to anything other than "reps" or "time", its monthly total equals the number of checked days in the selected month.
The monthly total/goal display for the "16/8 fasting" habit uses the same layout as other habits and appears in the existing monthly total row area.

file_operations.description: Ensure the non-(reps/time) unitType path is unitType-driven (not habit-name-driven) so that habits like "16/8 fasting" automatically use checked-days counting when their unitType is neither "reps" nor "time".
Confirm the monthly total/goal rendering is based on unitType and therefore applies consistently to "16/8 fasting" without any special-case layout, keeping it in the existing monthly total row area.

requirements.summary: Hide inline edit controls from the main grid; replace with a habit click pop-up showing one edit pen that opens a full edit modal for all editable habit details.
acceptanceCriteria: On the main habit grid, the per-field pencil/edit buttons for name/unit/volume are no longer shown (including on hover and on touch devices).
Clicking/tapping a habit row (or its habit-info cell) opens a contextual pop-up that displays a single pencil/edit action (not multiple edit icons).

Clicking/tapping the pencil/edit action opens a modal dialog where the user can edit: habit name, unit type, and the selected month’s volume/goal value (with the same validation rules currently used for time vs non-time volume input).
Saving changes from the modal updates the habit via the existing mutations and refresh/optimistically updates the grid accordingly.
Cancel/close leaves the habit unchanged and closes the modal.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable full habit edit modal that supports editing habit name, unit type, and the selected month’s volume/goal, reusing the existing time vs non-time validation and save behaviors. Use shadcn-ui dialog-related components to provide the modal UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a small contextual pop-up component that appears when the habit is clicked/tapped and shows a single pencil/edit action. Use shadcn-ui popover/dropdown-related components to provide the contextual pop-up behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Remove the inline/hover edit buttons and per-field inline editing UI from the habit info cell. Make clicking/tapping the habit info area open the new contextual pop-up with a single edit pen action; wire that action to open HabitEditModal. Ensure save/cancel flows call the existing mutations (updateHabit, updateHabitUnitType, updateHabitVolume) and the grid reflects changes via existing React Query invalidation/optimistic updates. Use shadcn-ui button/icon affordances as needed without modifying files under frontend/src/components/ui. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
